name_zh: 孔菲德拉西翁/原住民运动：安第斯联盟与乌班图式共识
name_en: CONAIE/Indigenous Movement: Andean Alliance & Ubuntu-Style Consensus
description_zh: 厄瓜多尔原住民民族联盟 (CONAIE) 1986 成立，历次起义(1990/1994/1997/2000/2005/2019/2022) 推动原住民权利/多民族国家/水权/反采掘/政治参与。核心动员模式：安第斯联盟 — 社区基础/轮值领袖/共识决策/明卡互助/安第斯宇宙观(帕查妈妈/苏马·考萨伊/美好生活)/跨阶级联盟(学生/工人/环保/左翼)。体现 M146 乌班图/安第斯共识 — 以"社区基础+轮值领袖+共识决策+安第斯宇宙观"四位一体，在国家精英/跨国公司/军队/媒体四强围剿中构建原住民主体性政治力量。
description_en: Ecuador Confederation of Indigenous Nationalities (CONAIE) founded 1986, multiple uprisings (1990/1994/1997/2000/2005/2019/2022) advanced indigenous rights/plurinational state/water rights/anti-extractivism/political participation. Core mobilization model: Andean Alliance — community base/rotating leadership/consensus decision/minka mutual aid/Andean cosmovision (Pachamama/Sumak Kawsay/Good Living)/cross-class alliances (students/workers/environmentalists/left). Exemplifies M146 Ubuntu/Andean Consensus — quaternity of 'community base + rotating leadership + consensus decision + Andean cosmovision' building indigenous political subjectivity amid quadruple siege of state elites/multinationals/military/media.
reason_zh: CONAIE 非单纯压力团体，而是"社区基础+轮值领袖+共识决策+安第斯宇宙观"四位一体政治主体。以社区为权力源头，轮值防精英化，共识超越多数决，宇宙观提供文明叙事。M146 区隔于 M146 乌班图(南非)、M164 美元化共识(厄瓜多尔)、M187 酋长制(加纳)，核心在于"社区即权力源头+轮值即反精英+共识即决策制+宇宙观即文明叙事"的安第斯原住民政治范式。
reason_en: CONAIE not mere pressure group but 'community base + rotating leadership + consensus decision + Andean cosmovision' quaternity political subject. Community as power source, rotation prevents elitization, consensus transcends majority vote, cosmovision provides civilizational narrative. M146 distinct from M146 Ubuntu (SA), M164 Dollarization Consensus (Ecuador), M187 Chiefship (Ghana), core: 'community as power source + rotation as anti-elite + consensus as decision rule + cosmovision as civilizational narrative' Andean indigenous political paradigm.
steps_zh: 社区基础与领土自治：社区(亚尤)/民族/联盟三级/领土自治/水/森林/矿产/教育/卫生/司法/自治权
轮值领袖与反精英机制：主席/副主席/秘书/轮值/任期/无连任/问责/社区监督/防止官僚化/领袖即仆人
共识决策与明卡互助：全体大会/讨论/共识/非多数决/明卡社区共工/互助/灾害/庆典/劳动即纽带
安第斯宇宙观与美好生活：帕查妈妈/大地母亲/苏马·考萨伊/美好生活/非GDP/和谐/互惠/生态/精神/文明替代性
跨阶级联盟与政治冲击：1990 起义/2000 马瓦恩/2005 帕拉西奥斯/2019 反紧缩/2022 反油气/拉索/诺沃亚/原住民议员/部长/政治重塑
steps_en: Community base & territorial autonomy: community (ayllu)/nationality/confederation three-tier/territorial autonomy/water/forest/minerals/education/health/justice/autonomy rights
Rotating leadership & anti-elite mechanism: president/VP/secretary/rotating/term/no re-election/accountability/community oversight/prevents bureaucratization/leader as servant
Consensus decision & minka mutual aid: general assembly/deliberation/consensus/not majority vote/minka community work/mutual aid/disaster/celebration/labor as bond
Andean cosmovision & Good Living: Pachamama/Mother Earth/Sumak Kawsay/Good Living/non-GDP/harmony/reciprocity/ecology/spiritual/civilizational alternative
Cross-class alliances & political impact: 1990 uprising/2000 Mahuad/2005 Palacio/2019 anti-austerity/2022 anti-oil/Lasso/Noboa/indigenous legislators/ministers/political reshaping
expected_zh: 以"社区基础+轮值领袖+共识决策+安第斯宇宙观"四位一体，在国家精英/跨国公司/军队/媒体四强围剿中构建原住民主体性政治力量，为拉美原住民运动提供组织与文明双重范式。
expected_en: Quaternity of 'community base + rotating leadership + consensus decision + Andean cosmovision' builds indigenous political subjectivity amid quadruple siege of state elites/multinationals/military/media, providing dual organizational & civilizational paradigm for Latin American indigenous movements.
